description: Figure 3 presents a pie chart summarizing the distribution of samples across the MMRA benchmark subtasks, with each slice representing one subtask category (a total of 8 slices). The slices are labeled with both an integer count and a percentage in parentheses, indicating the number of samples and their proportion of the full benchmark; the largest slice is labeled “ObservationAngle” and appears to be about 12.28% (126 samples), while the remaining slices are smaller and collectively make up the rest of the circle with their own count-and-percentage labels. The chart uses distinct colors to differentiate slices and includes percentage labels directly on or adjacent to the slices; no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond color and labeling, and the slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering rule.
